# Neo.code.executor.Neo omits ../ import prefix in dist/esm environment

## Context

While reviewing #21544 (`examples/code/livePreview`, `hiddenIn: []`), tracing `Neo.code.executor.Neo#execute` (`src/code/executor/Neo.mjs:110-136`) across the Portal's four build modes (`devmode`, `dist_dev`, `dist_esm`, `dist_prod`) uncovered that `dist/esm` (`Neo.config.environment === 'dist/esm'`, emitted by `esmDistTransforms.mjs:174`) has no import-path branch in `Neo.code.executor.Neo`.

Measured with Node's ES module loader (`new Function("return import(...)")` inside a mirrored `src/code/executor/Neo.mjs` tree):
- With `'../' + path` (`'../../functional/_export.mjs'`): resolves to `src/functional/_export.mjs` (`OK`).
- Unchanged (`'../functional/_export.mjs'`, what `environment === 'dist/esm'` passes today): rejects with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` (`.../dist/esm/src/code/functional/_export.mjs` — one directory too shallow).

## The Problem

Every runnable `neomjs`-language `Neo.code.LivePreview` snippet writes imports relative to `src/<topic>/` (e.g. `import {defineComponent, useConfig} from '../functional/_export.mjs';` and `import Button from '../button/Base.mjs';`).

In `dist/esm`:
- `esmDistTransforms.mjs:174` rewrites `neo-config.json` with `environment: 'dist/esm'`.
- `dist/esm/src/code/executor/Neo.mjs` sits at the exact same depth inside `dist/esm/src/` (`3` segments below `dist/esm/`) as `src/code/executor/Neo.mjs` sits inside the repo root (`3` segments below `/`).
- However, `src/code/executor/Neo.mjs:110` checks `if (environment === 'development')` only, omitting `|| environment === 'dist/esm'`.
- Consequently, switching the Portal or opening `dist/esm/examples/code/livePreview/index.html` under **Running the ESM build** leaves relative specifiers un-prefixed (`'../functional/_export.mjs'`), which resolve from `dist/esm/src/code/executor/Neo.mjs` to `dist/esm/src/code/functional/_export.mjs` (`404`) and render the error message instead of the component across the Portal home previews (`#21365`), Learn guides, and the new Live Preview catalog card (`#21483` / `#21544`).

## The Architectural Reality

- **Design authority:** `Neo.code.executor.Neo` class JSDoc (`src/code/executor/Neo.mjs:14`): *"Adjusting import paths based on the running environment (`development`, `dist/development`, `dist/production`) to ensure correct file resolution."* + engine-wide `dist/esm` unbundled-module parity (`src/worker/App.mjs:790`, `src/worker/Manager.mjs:14`, `src/worker/Data.mjs:97`, `src/remotes/Api.mjs:118`, `src/main/addon/Stylesheet.mjs:52`, all pairing `environment === 'development' || environment === 'dist/esm'`).
- **`src/code/executor/Neo.mjs:110-136`:**
  - `development`: prepends `'../'` to relative (`path.startsWith('.')`) specifiers so `'../button/Base.mjs'` becomes `'../../button/Base.mjs'` relative to `src/code/executor/Neo.mjs`.
  - `dist/development` & `dist/production`: webpack's `appworker.js` chunks sit at `dist/<env>/chunks/app/[id].js` (`2` levels inside `dist/<env>/`), so `'../../../../src/'` and `'../../../esm/src/'` already resolve for examples at any folder depth.
  - `dist/esm`: unbundled ES modules keep the `src/` directory layout inside `dist/esm/src/`, so `environment === 'dist/esm'` needs the exact same `'../' + path` prefix as `environment === 'development'`.

## The Fix

1. Update `src/code/executor/Neo.mjs:110` to handle `environment === 'development' || environment === 'dist/esm'`, and update its JSDoc (`:14`, `:75`) to name `dist/esm`.
2. Add a unit test in `test/playwright/unit/code/executor/Neo.spec.mjs` verifying that `Neo.code.executor.Neo#execute` resolves relative `../` imports identically under `Neo.config.environment = 'dist/esm'` and `'development'` (failing on `dev` where `'dist/esm'` leaves `'../'` un-prefixed and passing with the fix).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `Neo.code.executor.Neo#execute` rewrites relative (`path.startsWith('.')`) import specifiers with `'../' + path` when `Neo.config.environment === 'dist/esm'`, matching `'development'`.
- [ ] AC-2: `test/playwright/unit/code/executor/Neo.spec.mjs` includes a unit arm exercising `execute()` with a relative `'../...'` import under `Neo.config.environment = 'dist/esm'` that fails before the `src/code/executor/Neo.mjs` fix and passes with it, restoring `Neo.config.environment` in `afterEach`.
- [ ] AC-3: `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/code/` passes.

## Out of Scope

- Non-relative bare package specifiers or `markdown` / `mermaid` branches (`#21443`).
- Modifying `#21544` (`examples/code/livePreview`), whose `hiddenIn: []` declaration becomes true across all four builds once this engine fix lands.

## Avoided Traps

- Hiding `live-preview` in `dist_esm` (`hiddenIn: ['dist_esm']`): masks an engine bug that equally breaks Learn and Portal home `LivePreview` blocks when running `dist/esm`.
- Mutating `Neo.config.environment` in a unit spec without restoring the original value in `afterEach`.
